meta.description: Seed data parsed from Rutger's markdown meal-planning files

recipes.title: BBQ Baked Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potato & Green Beans
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Peel and cube sweet potatoes (~1-inch); toss with 1 tbsp oil, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 15 min.
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and remaining spices. Brush generously with BBQ sauce.
Push sweet potatoes to one side; add chicken to pan. Roast 20 min.
Toss green beans with remaining oil and a pinch of salt; add to pan around chicken. Roast 10–12 min until beans are tender and chicken reaches 175°F.
Brush with a second coat of BBQ sauce the last 5 min if desired. Cool and portion.

recipes.title: Beef Bolognese with Rigatoni
steps: Finely dice onion, carrot, celery. Sauté in olive oil over medium heat ~8 min until soft.
Add garlic; cook 1 min. Add tomato paste; cook 2 min, stirring.
Add ground beef; break up and brown fully, ~8 min. Drain excess fat if needed.
Add crushed tomatoes, beef broth, oregano, bay leaves, salt, pepper. Simmer uncovered 25–30 min until thickened. Remove bay leaves.
Boil rigatoni to al dente; toss with sauce. Portion with parmesan on top.

recipes.title: Beef Enchilada Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Sauté diced onion in oil ~4 min. Add garlic; 1 min. Add beef; brown and drain fat. Season with cumin, chili powder, salt. Stir in drained black beans.
Spread ½ cup enchilada sauce on the bottom of a 9×13 baking dish.

Layer: 4 tortillas (overlapping) → half the beef mixture → ½ cup sauce → ½ cup cheese. Repeat: 4 tortillas → remaining beef → ½ cup sauce → ½ cup cheese. Top with 4 tortillas → remaining sauce → remaining cheese.
Cover with foil; bake 25 min. Uncover; bake 10 min until cheese bubbles.
Cool 10 min before cutting into portions.

recipes.title: Beef Taco Salad

ingredients.note: add fresh at serving — don't store with salad

steps: Cook beef in oil over medium-high, breaking apart, ~8 min. Drain fat. Add taco seasoning and 2 tbsp water; stir 1 min. Cool completely.
Chop romaine. Halve cherry tomatoes. Drain and rinse beans and corn.
**Meal prep method:** portion romaine into 8 containers. Top each with beef, tomatoes, beans, corn, and cheddar. Pack salsa and sour cream in small side containers. Keep chips separate.
At lunch: squeeze lime over, add salsa and sour cream, crush chips on top, toss.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Meal Prep Salad
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Coat chicken with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, pepper. Bake 22–25 min until cooked through. Rest 5 min; slice thin.
Chop romaine into bite-sized pieces. Shave or grate parmesan.
**Meal prep method:** portion romaine into 8 airtight containers. Add sliced chicken on top. Keep dressing, croutons, and parmesan separate (store in small zip-lock bags or side containers).
At lunch, squeeze a little lemon over, add dressing and croutons, toss.

recipes.title: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowls

ingredients.note: optional — serve on the side for Rutger only

steps: Cook rice. Slice bell peppers; sauté in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high until charred at edges, ~8 min. Set aside.
Mince chipotles with their sauce. Toss chicken with chipotles, garlic, cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and 1 tbsp oil.
Cook chicken in the same skillet ~6 min/side until cooked through; rest 5 min, then slice or chop.
Warm black beans and corn in pan with a pinch of salt. Squeeze lime over everything.
Build bowls: rice → chicken → peppers → beans & corn. Portion and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chipotle Shredded Chicken (Bulk Base)
recipes.note: Base protein only — pair with a finish recipe each night. Freeze half immediately after cooking.
steps: Mince chipotles with their sauce. Combine with minced garlic, cumin, paprika, chili powder, salt, and olive oil into a paste.
Coat chicken thighs all over. Work in 2–3 batches: sear in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high, 4 min per side. (Or bake all at 425°F for 25 min.)
Once all chicken is cooked, shred with two forks while still warm.
Squeeze lime juice over; toss to coat. Taste for salt.
**Freeze half immediately** (6 servings) in a labeled freezer bag or container. Refrigerate the other half for week 1.

recipes.title: Coconut Chicken Curry with Rice
steps: Cook rice. Dice chicken. Sauté onion in oil until soft; add garlic, ginger, curry powder, 1 min.
Add chicken, brown lightly. Add diced tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 15 min until thickened (it's a sauce, not a soup).
Stir in spinach until wilted; season with salt.
Serve over rice; portion.

recipes.title: Finish — Beef Bolognese with Rigatoni (Italian)
recipes.note: Uses garlic-ground-beef-base (already cooked). The neutral beef absorbs the tomato and herb flavors quickly into a proper-tasting bolognese. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Boil rigatoni. Finely dice carrot and celery; soften in olive oil 5 min.
Add beef (already cooked), tomato paste; stir 1 min. Add crushed tomatoes, broth, oregano, bay leaf. Simmer 10–12 min until reduced and thick. Remove bay leaf.
Toss with pasta; finish with parmesan.

recipes.title: Finish — Beef Enchilada Bake
recipes.note: Uses tex-mex-ground-beef-base (already cooked). Makes 4 servings — covers 2 nights for 2 people. Assemble and bake; the active time is only 10 min since beef is pre-cooked. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Reheat beef; stir in drained black beans.
Spread ½ cup enchilada sauce in a 9×13 baking dish.
Layer: 4 tortillas → half the beef/bean mix → ½ cup sauce → ½ cup cheese. Repeat. Top with 4 tortillas → remaining sauce → remaining cheese.
Cover with foil; bake 25 min. Uncover; bake 10 min until bubbly.
Rest 10 min; slice into portions. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Finish — Beef Keema with Rice (Indian)
recipes.note: Uses garlic-ground-beef-base (already cooked). Keema = spiced ground meat, a classic Indian preparation. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Cook basmati rice. In a skillet, warm oil over medium; add ginger and garlic, cook 1 min.
Add curry powder and garam masala; stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add beef (already cooked) and diced tomatoes; stir to combine. Simmer 8 min until most liquid is absorbed.
Stir in peas; heat through 2 min. Squeeze lemon over. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Finish — Beef Pasta with Marinara
recipes.note: Uses tex-mex-ground-beef-base (already cooked). The taco seasoning blends right in once the marinara goes on — tastes fully Italian. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water. In a separate pan, warm olive oil and sliced garlic 1 min; add beef and marinara. Simmer together 5 min — the marinara absorbs the seasoning and it tastes like a quick bolognese.
Toss pasta with sauce. Finish with parmesan and red pepper flakes.

recipes.title: Finish — Beef Stroganoff over Egg Noodles (Eastern European)
recipes.note: Uses garlic-ground-beef-base (already cooked). Classic Russian-style creamy mushroom sauce over egg noodles. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Boil egg noodles. Slice mushrooms; sauté in butter over medium-high until browned, ~6 min.
Add beef (already cooked), broth, Worcestershire, and Dijon; stir to combine, 2 min.
Remove from heat; stir in sour cream (don't boil or it'll split). Season with salt and pepper.
Serve over egg noodles; top with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Finish — Beef Taco Bowls
recipes.note: Uses tex-mex-ground-beef-base (already cooked). This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Cook rice. Warm black beans and corn in a small pan.
Reheat beef in a skillet with a splash of water, 3–4 min.
Build bowls: rice → beef → beans/corn → cheese → sour cream. Squeeze lime over.

recipes.title: Finish — Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowls
recipes.note: Uses chipotle-shredded-chicken-base (already cooked). This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Cook rice (takes ~18 min; start this first). Warm black beans and corn in a small pan with a pinch of salt.
Reheat shredded chicken in a skillet with a splash of water over medium.
Build bowls: rice → chicken → beans/corn → salsa. Squeeze lime over. Cilantro on the side for Rutger.

recipes.title: Finish — Chicken Cacciatore with Pasta (Italian)
recipes.note: Uses lemon-herb-chicken-base (already cooked). This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water. In a skillet, warm olive oil and sliced garlic 1 min.
Add crushed tomatoes, olives, capers, oregano, red pepper flakes. Simmer 8 min until slightly thickened.
Stir in shredded chicken; heat through 2–3 min.
Toss with drained pasta. Finish with parmesan.

recipes.title: Finish — Chicken Coconut Curry (Thai-style)
recipes.note: Uses lemon-herb-chicken-base (already cooked). Uses store-bought Thai red or green curry paste — no complex prep. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.

ingredients.item: Thai red or green curry paste

steps: Cook rice. In a saucepan, cook curry paste over medium heat 1 min until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk; stir smooth. Add fish sauce and brown sugar; simmer 5 min.
Add shredded chicken; heat through 3 min. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Taste for salt and balance (more lime = brighter, more fish sauce = savory, more sugar = mellow). Serve over rice with a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Finish — Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas
recipes.note: Uses chipotle-shredded-chicken-base (already cooked). This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Reheat chicken in a skillet; set aside.

Melt a small amount of butter in a large skillet over medium. Place one tortilla; spread chicken and a generous layer of cheese over half. Fold. Cook 2–3 min per side until golden and cheese is melted. Repeat for second quesadilla.
Cut into wedges. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Finish — Chipotle Chicken Street Tacos
recipes.note: Uses chipotle-shredded-chicken-base (already cooked). This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Warm tortillas directly over a gas burner or in a dry skillet until slightly charred. Double them up (2 per taco).
Reheat chicken in a skillet with a splash of water, 2–3 min.
Dice tomato; shred or chop lettuce. Squeeze lime over chicken.
Fill tacos: chicken → cheese → lettuce → tomato → hot sauce → sour cream.

recipes.title: Finish — Chicken Tzatziki Bowls (Greek)
recipes.note: Uses lemon-herb-chicken-base (already cooked). No cooking required — just assembly. This recipe covers finishing ingredients only.
steps: Cook rice. Dice cucumber; halve cherry tomatoes; thinly slice red onion.
Reheat chicken in a skillet with a splash of water; squeeze lemon over, sprinkle oregano.
Build bowls: rice → chicken → cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olives → crumbled feta → a generous spoonful of tzatziki.

recipes.title: Garlic Ground Beef (Bulk Base)
recipes.note: Neutral base — minimal seasoning so it can absorb Italian, Indian, or Eastern European finishes cleanly. Freeze 6 servings immediately after cooking for week 2.
steps: Dice onions. Heat oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high.
Sauté onion 5 min until soft. Add garlic; cook 1 min.
Add beef in batches; break apart and brown fully. Drain excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.
**Freeze half immediately** (6 servings) in a labeled bag. Refrigerate the other half for week 1.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken with Roasted Potatoes & Tomatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve potatoes; toss on a large sheet pan with 2 tbsp oil, oregano, thyme, salt, pepper. Roast 20 min.
Meanwhile, whisk remaining 2 tbsp oil, juice of 1.5 lemons, garlic, garlic powder, oregano, salt, pepper. Coat chicken.
Push potatoes aside; add chicken to pan. Scatter cherry tomatoes around. Roast 20–22 min until chicken reaches 175°F and potatoes are golden.
Squeeze remaining lemon half over everything. Cool and portion.

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Pulled Chicken (Bulk Base)
recipes.note: Neutral base — pairs with Italian, Greek, Thai, or American finishes. Freeze 6 servings immediately after cooking for week 2.
steps: Smash and mince garlic. Coat chicken with olive oil, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, pepper, and juice of 2 lemons.
Sear in batches in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high, ~4 min per side until cooked through. (Or bake at 425°F for 25 min.)
Rest 5 min; shred with two forks. Squeeze remaining lemon over and toss.
**Freeze half immediately** (6 servings) in a labeled bag. Refrigerate the other half for week 1.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Potatoes & Green Beans
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve potatoes; toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 15 min.
Toss chicken with oil, paprika, oregano, minced garlic, salt, pepper.
Add chicken to the pan with the potatoes; roast 15 min.
Add green beans (tossed with a little oil), roast 10–12 min more until chicken reaches 175°F and beans are tender.
Squeeze lemon over. Cool and portion.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Steak Fajita Bowls
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cook rice. Slice peppers and onion; toss on a sheet pan with 1 tbsp oil and half the spices. Roast 10 min.
Slice steak thin; toss with remaining oil, spices, minced garlic, salt.
Push veg aside, add steak to the pan; roast 8–10 min to desired doneness.
Squeeze lime over. Serve over rice as bowls; portion.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Ground Beef & Rice Skillet
steps: Sauté diced onion in oil over medium-high ~4 min. Add garlic; cook 1 min.
Add beef; brown fully, ~7 min. Drain excess fat. Add taco seasoning; stir 1 min.
Add uncooked rice, beef broth, salsa. Stir, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and cook 18 min until rice absorbs liquid.
Stir in black beans and corn; heat through 2–3 min. Squeeze lime over. Top with cheese.
Cool and portion; keep cheese on top or separate for reheating.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Ground Beef (Bulk Base)
recipes.note: Base protein only — pair with a finish recipe each night. Freeze half immediately after cooking.
steps: Dice onions. Heat oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high.
Sauté onion 5 min until soft. Add garlic; cook 1 min.
Add beef in batches; break apart and brown fully. Drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning and salt; stir 2 min.
**Freeze half immediately** (6 servings) in a labeled freezer bag or container. Refrigerate the other half for week 1.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara with Spaghetti
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, grated onion, minced garlic, salt, pepper.
Roll into meatballs; bake 18–20 min.
Simmer meatballs in marinara 10 min. Boil spaghetti.
Serve meatballs + sauce over pasta; portion.
